extracted.intended_audience: PR professionals, corporate communications and media-relations teams, marketing staff preparing press/media kits
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for assembling and maintaining press kits and media kits (digital and occasional physical) that support press releases and journalists' needs. Covers required components, format/distribution, and an implicit quality checklist for assessing kit completeness and usefulness.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press Kit characteristics
rubrics_metrics.description: Tied to specific announcement; 5Ws focused; Multimedia for the story; Time-sensitive; Distributed with press release
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used alongside a particular announcement or news item; should emphasize who/what/when/where/why and provide multimedia tailored to that story; typically distributed with a press release.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Kit characteristics
rubrics_metrics.description: Fuller picture of brand identity; Always available; Comprehensive; Updated periodically; Self-service for journalists
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Serves as an evergreen, self-service resource about the organization and brand; maintained and updated periodically so journalists can access background material at any time.

rubrics_metrics.name: Company Information
rubrics_metrics.description: Mission and values statement; Company overview (one-pager); History and key milestones; Awards and recognitions; Office locations; Employee count; Industry positioning
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide concise, downloadable company overview(s) and verifiable facts that help journalists understand context and positioning; include milestone timelines and recognitions for credibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Press Releases (in kit)
rubrics_metrics.description: 3-5 recent newsworthy releases; Archive link to all releases; Categorized by topic
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include several recent, relevant press releases and an easily accessible archive; organizing releases by topic improves discoverability for reporters researching a beat.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Assets
rubrics_metrics.description: High-resolution logos (multiple formats); Product images; Headshots of leadership; Office/facility photos; Brand guidelines; Color palettes; Stock photo libraries
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply multiple file formats and high-resolution files (logos in SVG/PNG/JPG, large images) and brand guidelines so media can reproduce assets accurately; organize and label files clearly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Leadership / People
rubrics_metrics.description: Bios of executives; Professional headshots; Quotes/sound bites; Speaker availability; Areas of expertise
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide up-to-date bios and headshots with suggested quotable soundbites and spokespeople availability; include expertise tags to help journalists find interview subjects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Media Coverage / Earned Media
rubrics_metrics.description: Links to past press features; Interview clips; Magazine articles; Podcast appearances; Video clips
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document and link to notable coverage and appearances to demonstrate media interest and third-party validation; include clips or embed where possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistics / Fact Sheets
rubrics_metrics.description: Key metrics; Industry stats; Customer demographics; Geographic reach; Year-over-year growth
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide succinct fact sheets and verified metrics for quick reference by reporters; include sources or methodology for statistics when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact Information
rubrics_metrics.description: Direct press contacts; Email addresses; Phone numbers; Social media handles; Website URLs; Time zones
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List one or more direct, responsive media contacts with multiple contact methods and time zone context; ensure contacts are monitored during news cycles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional Elements (supplementary materials)
rubrics_metrics.description: Videos (corporate, product); Case studies; Customer testimonials; Awards (with images of trophies); White papers; Research reports; Brand guidelines; Annual reports
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include deeper assets for journalists who need background or supporting evidence; clearly label proprietary vs. shareable materials and provide download-friendly formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital Press Kit format and features
rubrics_metrics.description: Newsroom landing page; Downloadable PDF; Embedded multimedia; Mobile-friendly; Searchable
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create a dedicated, discoverable newsroom page that aggregates assets, supports downloads, embeds multimedia, and is optimized for mobile and search to maximize journalist access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Physical Press Kit format and features
rubrics_metrics.description: Folder with materials; USB with multimedia; Printed business card; Used at conferences/events
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When used (rare today), assemble professionally printed folders and portable media (USB) for in-person events; include a clear business card/contact sheet and durable packaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Easy to find on website
rubrics_metrics.description: A press kit is high-quality if it is easy to find on website
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Place newsroom/press kit link in global navigation, footer, or through prominent linking from the home page; ensure SEO-friendly URLs and metadata so journalists can locate it quickly.

rubrics_metrics.name: All assets downloadable
rubrics_metrics.description: A press kit is high-quality if all assets are downloadable
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide direct-download links for logos, images, and documents rather than forcing requests; use common file formats and avoid gated downloads requiring form fills where possible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Logos in multiple formats
rubrics_metrics.description: A press kit is high-quality if logos in multiple formats (SVG, PNG, JPG) are provided
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include vector formats (SVG, EPS) plus common raster formats at multiple resolutions and provide clear usage notes (safe area, color variations).

rubrics_metrics.name: High-resolution images
rubrics_metrics.description: A press kit is high-quality if it contains high-resolution images
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply large, print-quality images (300 DPI where relevant) and web-optimized versions; label resolution and intended use for each file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Updated within 6 months
rubrics_metrics.description: A press kit is high-quality if updated within 6 months
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Regularly review and refresh content (bios, metrics, recent press, assets) at least twice a year or whenever leadership/brand changes occur; date-stamp files where useful.

rubrics_metrics.name: Includes recent press releases
rubrics_metrics.description: A press kit is high-quality if it includes recent press releases
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure recent and relevant releases are present (recommended 3-5) and archive older items in an accessible way; tag releases by topic/date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Has expert bios with photos
rubrics_metrics.description: A press kit is high-quality if it has expert bios with photos
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide concise bios and professional headshots for spokespeople; include contact and availability notes and areas of expertise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provides quotable quotes
rubrics_metrics.description: A press kit is high-quality if it provides quotable quotes
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply pre-approved, short, media-friendly quotes from executives to expedite coverage while ensuring message consistency; label context and attribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Has video assets
rubrics_metrics.description: A press kit is high-quality if it has video assets
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include embeddable and downloadable video clips (B-roll, interviews, product demos) with transcripts and clear usage rights for broadcasters.

rubrics_metrics.name: Has clear press contact
rubrics_metrics.description: A press kit is high-quality if it has a clear press contact
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List a primary media contact with phone, email, and hours; include backup contacts for after-hours or holiday coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Has fact sheet
rubrics_metrics.description: A press kit is high-quality if it has a fact sheet
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a one-page fact sheet summarizing essential stats and company facts for quick reporter reference; include citations or source notes for figures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Has past media coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: A press kit is high-quality if it has past media coverage
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Curate and link to notable past coverage and embed clips where possible to demonstrate credibility and story traction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mobile-accessible
rubrics_metrics.description: A press kit is high-quality if it is mobile-accessible
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure newsroom pages and downloadable assets render and download correctly on mobile devices; avoid large uncompressed files that block mobile access.

rubrics_metrics.name: Categorized for navigation
rubrics_metrics.description: A press kit is high-quality if it is categorized for navigation
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organize assets and documents by category (e.g., leadership, products, press releases, multimedia) and provide search or filtering to speed journalist workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: Brand guidelines included
rubrics_metrics.description: A press kit is high-quality if brand guidelines are included
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide official brand guidelines, usage rules for logos and colors, and downloadable assets to prevent incorrect or off-brand representation.
